title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2610.28611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes during cascading failures remains an arduous task for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), bottlenecked by manual keyword filtering and disjointed temporal correlation across monitoring dashboards. We introduce Semantic Observability, an autonomous multi-agent framework that unifies disparate log streams into a dynamic, queryable Property Graph Database. By modeling physical infrastructure topologies, logical software dependencies, and chronological event sequences as attributed nodes and directed relations, it bridges the semantic gap inherent in flat, unstructured log repositories. Building on this unified substrate, we deploy a stateful multi-agent system orchestrated through Directed Cyclic Graphs (DCGs). The system autonomously navigates

translated_title: 面向自主系统诊断的语义可观测性
translated_abstract: 现代分布式微服务部署在物理和逻辑分区的基础设施上产生海量的异构、多格式可观测性日志。在级联故障期间隔离根本原因对站点可靠性工程师（SRE）而言仍然是一项艰巨的任务，其瓶颈在于人工关键词过滤以及跨监控仪表盘之间割裂的时序关联分析。我们提出了语义可观测性（Semantic Observability），这是一个自主多智能体框架，将不同的日志流统一到一个动态、可查询的属性图数据库中。通过将物理基础设施拓扑、逻辑软件依赖关系和按时间顺序排列的事件序列建模为带属性的节点和有向关系，它弥合了扁平、非结构化日志存储库中固有的语义鸿沟。基于这一统一的底层结构，我们部署了一个通过有向循环图（DCG）编排的有状态多智能体系统，该系统能够自主导航……
tldr: 该论文提出“语义可观测性”自主多智能体框架，通过将异构日志流统一建模为动态可查询的属性图数据库，并利用有向循环图编排的有状态多智能体系统，弥合非结构化日志的语义鸿沟，帮助SRE在级联故障中自动定位根本原因。
